annotations.title: Start a content loop from a video

description: One call for steps 2 to 4 of the content loop: decode a video (url, a competitor post_id from competitor_posts_browse, or an idea_id whose proof post is a video), make the look (recipe_from_reference), write the brief and shot list (reference_to_brief), and open a draft post (kind video, no accounts yet) titled from the hook. Returns {loop_id, recipe_id, brief, shot_list, draft_post_id, next:"film"}: she films the shots on her phone, then edit_job_open with the brief. Returns {state:"studying"} while the study runs; call again. The same video gives the same loop and draft. Nothing posts.

idea_id.description: An idea from ideas_list; its draft is made through idea_draft

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
